Title: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes (Hungry Happens)

Items: 2 lb (≈ 0.91 kg) chicken thighs, bone-in + skin-on
1 1/3 lb (≈ 0.61 kg) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into quarters
Juice of about 1 1/3 medium lemons (practically: 1 large + 1 small, or 2 small)
1/3 tsp paprika (plus extra to sprinkle on top, optional)

Instructions: Rinse and pat dry the chicken pieces.
Peel and cut the potatoes into quarters.
In a large bowl, toss chicken and potatoes with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, thyme, chili flakes, paprika, salt, and pepper until well coated.
Transfer to a baking dish, making sure the chicken pieces are touching the bottom of the pan. Potatoes can be in between and on top.
Sprinkle a little extra paprika over the top (optional).
Cover the pan with parchment paper, then seal tightly with aluminum foil. Roast for 45 minutes.
Uncover and roast for another 15 minutes, or until chicken and potatoes are browned and crispy.
Check chicken is cooked through (internal temperature should read 165°F / 74°C).
OptionalInstructions: Optional garnish: fresh chopped oregano and lemon slices.
You can also use bone-in, skin-on chicken legs or a whole chicken (cut into parts).
Any potatoes will work, but Yukon Gold are ideal here.
ServingSuggestions: Spoon the sauce/pan juices from the bottom of the pan over the chicken and potatoes when serving.
